name: Problem Solver
description: Problem Bob fixes bugs, Buster Bob guides you through building a level, and Level Beater Bob coaches you through hard parts.

menu-button.name: Main Menu Button
menu-button.description: Shows Bob's blue robot button next to the Geode button on the main menu.

always-intro.name: Dig Out Every Time
always-intro.description:
<cy>On</c>: Bob bursts out of the ground every time you press his button.
<cy>Off</c>: only the first time each game session, after that he's already out.

fix-announcements.name: Fix Announcements
fix-announcements.description: Bob pops up on the main menu to tell you about each bug he has fixed (once per fix).

voice-blips.name: Talking Blips
voice-blips.description: Little blip sounds while Bob's text types out.

editor-button.name: Editor Pause Button
editor-button.description: Shows Buster Bob's button in the editor pause menu (the <cy>||</c> button). This is how you open him on mobile.

editor-key.name: Open Buster Bob Key
editor-key.description: Press this in the editor to open Buster Bob (PC).

level-beater.name: Level Beater Bob
level-beater.description: Bob keeps count of where you die and pops in with tips when one part keeps getting you. He never plays for you, so your runs stay legit.

deaths-before-tip.name: Deaths Before A Tip
deaths-before-tip.description: How many deaths in the same part before Bob gives you a tip.

new-best-cheer.name: Cheer On New Best
new-best-cheer.description: Bob cheers when you beat your best percent for this play session (from 10% up).

in-practice.name: Tips In Practice Mode
in-practice.description: Also give tips while you're in practice mode.
